entries.25b5554066740720: Since its founding in 1947, the company has been a specialist manufacturer that has continued to produce and sell legwear. It operates its own factory in Yantai, China, and in Japan has a structure in which consolidated subsidiaries handle manufacturing and logistics. In innerwear, it holds Renaun Inkusu Co., Ltd., which took over the innerwear division of former Renown, and has a wide range of sales channels, including apparel specialty stores, EC and OEM.

entries.27525fc4b6a3f80e: This is the group's principal business, engaged in the manufacture, purchase and sale of legwear and innerwear, among others. The company, Renown Inks Co., Ltd., Atsugi Tohoku Co., Ltd., and subsidiaries in China, among others, handle manufacturing, purchasing and sales, and this includes contracted logistics operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,156 million, accounting for about 94% of the group as a whole. The principal brand of women's stockings is “ASTIGU (Asutīgu)”.
